snippet.title: The Fight Business - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Ever wondered what it would be like to take an unknown MMA fighter and turn them into a world champion?

Welcome to The Fight Business, an MMA management simulation where you're the coach behind the fighters, making the decisions that shape their careers.

Discover new talent, build your gym, hire coaches, develop your fighters' skills and prepare them for the biggest fights of their lives.

Every fighter has their own strengths, weaknesses and potential. Every decision matters. Some will become legends, others might never make it out of the amateur scene.

Developed by two brothers at Arkatee Studios, The Fight Business has been over a year in the making, and we're excited to finally share our first gameplay trailer.

Wishlist The Fight Business on Steam

Features:

Build and manage your own MMA gym

Scout, recruit and develop fighters

Hire coaches and create training programmes

Develop strategies and prepare for upcoming opponents

Manage fighter careers from unknown prospects to world champions

Experience a dynamic MMA world where every fighter's journey is different

Leave your legacy. Become a Legend.

Developed and published by Arkatee Studios.

#TheFightBusiness #MMAGame #IndieGame #ManagementGame #MMA #Gaming #SimulationGame
